E0046

`?.` optional chaining reaches fields, not methods (S71)

What

`?.` optional chaining reaches fields, not methods (S71)

Why

The registered parse rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0046

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0046: tests/ui/opt_chain_method.stderr.

Error [E0046]: optional chaining `?.` only reaches fields, not methods
  --> tests/ui/opt_chain_method.jet:6:13
    |
  6 |     z :: c?.show()
    |             ^^^^
 Why: `a?.b` short-circuits a `?T` to absent; calling through `?.` isn't in yet
 Fix: unwrap first, e.g. `(a ?? return).method()`, or test with `== present`
